name: code-block
title: Code block
description: Code to read and copy in the flow: framed (a plate with a head) or ghost; numbers from any start line, wrap, a max height with its own scroll, the copy glyph turning to the check on the drum. Highlighted and focused lines, lines picked by their numbers to reference in a chat, diff and unified patch (two gutters), diagnostics with an action, streaming from an AI reply with splitFences for Markdown. Highlighting is the host's (pass html); a light tint is built in.
